{"baseRefName":"main","body":"## Summary

- Adds `CondenseAndMarkFullyCondensed` called from the session-end hook — condenses session data to `entire/checkpoints/v1` immediately when the agent stops and marks `FullyCondensed=true`
- PostCommit skips `FullyCondensed+ENDED` sessions at the top of the processing loop, paying only a cheap JSON load + field check instead of shadow branch tree traversal (~73-103ms saved per accumulated session)
- Removes the force-condense time gate (`forceCondenseThreshold`, `isStaleEnded`) — sessions with no `FilesTouched` at stop time are condensed eagerly; sessions with `FilesTouched` wait for their files to be committed via the normal overlap path
- Drops the shadow-tree session discovery approach (added then reverted) — not needed since the eager-condense + `isFullyCondensedEnded` skip is sufficient

## Test plan

- [x] `mise run test:ci` passes (unit + integration + e2e canary)

- [x] `TestSubagentAccumulation_Issue591` — subagents eagerly condensed at stop, skipped on subsequent commits
- [x] `TestCarryForward_EndedSession_NotCondensedOnUnrelatedCommit` — ENDED sessions with carry-forward files NOT condensed into unrelated commits

Fixes #591
